name: Light academia

card.summary: A bright, cream-and-beige scholarly clothing aesthetic (cardigans, sweater vests, pleated skirts) that gives a soft, polished, approachable look.

quick.overview:
Light academia is an internet aesthetic that pairs a love of learning with sunny, optimistic imagery. In clothing it means a neutral, earthy palette of white, beige and brown, built from pieces such as cardigans, sweater vests, pleated skirts, dress shirts, turtlenecks and hair ribbons.

For appearance, it offers a coherent, easy-to-assemble style that reads as polished and gentle. It draws on school uniforms and early-to-mid twentieth-century college wear, and has been described as cottagecore with more cosmopolitan touches.
quick.how: People build outfits from layered knitwear, collared shirts, pleated or tailored bottoms and neutral colours, and add accessories like ribbons or satchels. The look is usually shared through mood boards on Tumblr and Pinterest and secondhand marketplaces such as Depop.
quick.risks: There are no health risks specific to the style. As with any trend aesthetic, its popularity is tied to online fashion cycles.

lead: Light academia is an internet aesthetic and subculture that emphasises bright visuals and positive themes such as optimism, joy and friendship [1]. The term was coined on Tumblr in 2019 by a user called plantaires, whose post imagined a hopeful, sunny version of academic life [1].

It is widely seen as the lighter counterpart to dark academia. Tumblr trend analyst Amanda Brennan said it still embodies the love of learning but with a breezier mood, setting knowledge in cheerful outdoor places rather than gothic ones [1].

In dress, the palette is neutral and earthy (white, beige, brown) and typical pieces include pleated skirts, dress shirts, sweater vests, cardigans, turtlenecks and hair ribbons, drawing on school uniforms and early-to-mid twentieth-century college wear [1].

angle.text: Light academia gives a ready-made palette and set of garments that people wear to look soft, put-together and collegiate. It is a clothing and styling choice rather than a change to the face or body.

infobox: Cardigans, sweater vests, pleated skirts, turtlenecks, hair ribbons [1]

paras: Light academia treats scholarship as warm and hopeful rather than brooding. Visual references include classic school and college uniforms, and works associated with it include Brideshead Revisited, Little Women, Pride & Prejudice (2005), Anne with an E and Gilmore Girls [1].

On Tumblr it ranked seventh among the top ten aesthetics by the end of 2020 and third by the end of 2021 [1]. Pinterest users tagging light academia clothing rose 236-fold from December 2021 to December 2022, and Depop searches rose 900 percent by October 2022 [1]. Nylon, Mashable and other outlets have covered the trend, and Collins Dictionary listed the term as a submission in 2022 [1].

timeline.event: Term coined on Tumblr by plantaires [1].
Ranks third among Tumblr aesthetics at year end [1].
Pinterest and Depop interest surges; Collins Dictionary lists the term as a submission [1].
